data.name: Copycat
data.description: You can create an illusory double of yourself as a move action. This double functions as a single Mirror Image and lasts for %1 rounds, or until the illusory duplicate is dispelled or destroyed. You can have no more than one Copycat at a time. This ability does not stack with the Mirror Image spell. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|DomainTrickeryLVL|CopycatTimes
